name: manual_5d6d3f
claim: Fixed-in replies on review threads can wake the Cursor autofix automation: on a closed PR its parallel passes mostly verified and declined to push, yet one pass re-created the deleted branch with duplicate lessons under the operator identity; do not post fixed-in replies on a closed PR, read the PR timeline before attributing a branch to another agent, and have the operator scope the automation to open PRs.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-26 PR 522 timeline: replies posted before the close triggered cursor[bot] automation 2d5e7b4f; four passes declined, one pass pushed bc2e82de to a branch deleted four minutes earlier; the branch was removed again and the tip kept only as a local tag.
